check: Share Ingress on an iPhone simulator through the system's own controls: the Paste button, the document picker, and the share sheet from Photos into the share extension, then review, Add, and the receipt
limitations: Simulator path: an iPhone 17 Pro simulator on iOS 27.0, not a device. It supports implemented at most.
The share extension and App Group staging on a physical iPhone did not run: a free Personal Team cannot sign App Groups.
The simulator signs the App Group with no team, which a device build cannot do.
The harness, not a person, tapped the controls, and put the note on the simulator's pasteboard. No VoiceOver, Voice Control, or large text pass was run.
Only an image and a movie were shared; a shared link or text was not added from the share sheet in this run (LAB-007-A added a Safari link that way in the simulator).
No iCloud Drive or iCloud Photos download ran, so no cloud download was cancelled.
The share sheet and Photos are the system's; their screens are not kept.

outcome.detail: The Import tab read “Share sheet: on.” The Paste button staged the note, “1 item is waiting for review.”, listed as “Harbor walk, Text, Paste”. On its review screen New Collection… and Add to Collection committed it: the receipt read Create Item, Committed, “Created item “Harbor walk” in “Field notes”.”, Entry point App UI, with an Archive undo. Choose Files… picked gull-count.txt from On My iPhone, listed as “gull-count.txt, File, File picker”. From Photos, the image and the movie shared to Native Lab showed “2 items are waiting for review.” in the extension, with “Item 1 is waiting for review.” and “Item 2 is waiting for review.”. The host then listed “harbor-sketch.PNG, File, Share sheet, 1 of 2” and “tide-clip.MOV, File, Share sheet, 2 of 2”. The movie's review screen read Came through: Share sheet; Position: 2 of 2 shared together; Declared type: com.apple.quicktime-movie; Adds as: Share extension; and that files cannot be added yet. The audits reported 13 issues on the Import tab, 13 on the text review screen, and 10 on the file review screen: Dynamic Type partially unsupported on section footers and form rows, contrast nearly passed on section headers and footers, contrast failed on one footer, and the Choose Files… label clipped.
